## Trace identity audit

A trace identifier needs a documented cardinality before a count can become a denominator. A retry can carry the same business identity while emitting a new attempt identity; instrumentation can emit two completion records for one attempt. The worksheet asks reviewers to retain both relationships rather than collapse every repeated identifier or count every span independently. Deduplicating by duration alone would remove genuinely separate commands that happen to take the same time. The later audit must establish which completion records duplicate an execution. Until then, an apparent count mismatch is a specific uncertainty. Withdrawing a compromised sample is more honest than inventing a repaired median without the underlying rows, and does not invalidate an unrelated incident cohort.

## Consumer of the evidence

Different consumers need different levels of explanation. A source preview can describe the worksheet's capacity question and disclose that local statistics have changed; an article about lease ownership needs the command distinction and the governing exclusion. A project summary needs open review state rather than every table detail. None should treat a generated preview as a new corroborating source. The original retained revision remains the evidence owner, and a source replacement should invalidate an older preview's freshness. The worksheet supports useful partial views with explicit limitations. A concise display is not permission to hide the duplicate-tracing rule when the displayed number depends on it, or to substitute presentation limits for complete topic maintenance.

## Critical-distinction review

A consequential merge should compare the actual accepted prose with the supported distinctions, not merely confirm that input documents were read. For this worksheet the essential questions are whether command and lease differ, whether median and p95 belong to different cohorts, whether the local sample remains valid, and whether recovery has been confused with capacity approval. A merged article can use different wording and organization while preserving those facts. A checklist is not an independent source and must stay with evaluation rather than imported evidence. The review should identify a precise missing qualification instead of requiring a witness sentence for every input fragment or allowing one technical rejection to stop unrelated updates.

## Historical versus current claims

A historical explanation may say that reviewers first transcribed one value and later corrected it, but a current recommendation cannot cite that chronology as if both values independently confirm the result. When the denominator is withdrawn, history explains the error rather than supplying valid measurement evidence. The worksheet retains the paired-span diagnostic and the incident recovery limitations because they do not depend on the compromised local sample. A generated page should distinguish explanatory history from current evidence in its wording and citations. Updating that distinction is routine supported maintenance, not a user decision about which number to prefer. The source does not provide enough raw rows to select a new numerical substitute.

## Release-path review

Release instrumentation should observe the application's disposal boundary rather than only the server's statement completion. A driver may return a connection to its internal pool after a command finishes, or the application may retain an object until a larger scope ends; the worksheet does not assume one implementation. Reviewers ask which object owns release and whether the trace records that event directly. A proposed test pairs checkout with normal completion, exception handling and cancellation, using synthetic state rather than a live service. The result sought is a complete boundary map, not a copied timing target. Missing ownership documentation remains a limitation. It cannot be repaired by treating a successful SQL response as proof that every application-held resource became available.

## Evidence coverage

A table continuation should carry the question label and column names so a retrieved fragment retains its meaning. Repeating structural labels is not new evidence and cannot count as corroboration. A retained source range identifies original text, while an index-generated block identifier identifies a representation created by the actual splitter. This worksheet supplies no fabricated chunk numbers. A later indexing evaluation must map measured ranges to real active revision locators and check the governing tail in the retrieved content. If a representation loses the tail, a synopsis must report limited coverage rather than imply that the omitted exception was absent. Full retained text alone does not prove the index or synthesis path preserved every distinction.

## Window alignment

Window boundaries are recorded before comparing latency, occupancy and memory. A twenty-minute healthy period can establish that the observed workload recovered without proving all-day stability. A later command sample can be recorded on an earlier date yet released to a review at a later stage; release order is not a timestamp filter. The worksheet keeps event time distinct from revision order to avoid treating an older recorded date as an obsolete correction. Reviewers compare evidence under its exact source revision. Combining partial windows across a cancellation or worker restart requires an explicit rationale, not an automatic concatenation that hides interruption. No stage in this profile claims that an actual service was restarted.

## Missing-data treatment

Missing data is a category of evidence quality rather than a numerical measurement. An absent command end cannot be encoded as a zero duration, and an absent checkout cannot be interpreted as immediate acquisition. The worksheet records an excluded-row count with the reason and avoids carrying those exclusions into a different cohort by default. A useful partial answer can describe observed paired rows while naming the unmeasured paths. It should not withhold all known recovery facts because one diagnostic remains incomplete, nor convert a partial result into comprehensive certification. The follow-up task is to collect the missing boundary in a bounded synthetic comparison, not to approve a production configuration based on silence.

## SQL-plan alternative

A query-plan change is a separate explanation from queueing for a free lease. The incident phase split points to acquisition waits while execution stayed near its previous range; that weakens a slow-query explanation for that specific cohort. It does not assert that every query plan is healthy forever. The worksheet asks whether command mix changed before comparing aggregate execution, since different statement types can move a median without any plan regression. A later local median cannot retroactively establish the incident plan state. The article should preserve the bounded rejection of one hypothesis, with its cohort, instead of publishing a global claim that database execution never contributes to latency.

## Pool-maximum interpretation

The recorded restoration to a maximum of 100 describes the recovered workload, not a recommended default for every replica or database. Pool maxima bound potential ownership but do not determine how many leases are simultaneously demanded, how long each is held or how much memory accompanies it. The worksheet therefore separates an operational recovery observation from a capacity decision. Capacity sign-off remains open until selected topology, concurrency and query mix have measurements. A new local command statistic does not supply that missing evidence. Any generated recommendation must retain this distinction even if a historical article title sounds like a tuning guide. A human title cannot authorize an otherwise unsupported deployment instruction.

## Database ceiling

A database connection ceiling and an application pool maximum operate at different boundaries. Multiple callers, services and replica generations may share the database ceiling, while one process enforces its own pool policy. The worksheet proposes accounting for other workload classes without naming production tenants or endpoints. It treats configured demand as a possible envelope and observed demand as an actual sample. Neither number alone establishes whether a database-side limit caused the incident. An article can explain why multiplying replicas matters, but cannot invent a database capacity value missing from the fixture. Related infrastructure topics remain distinct from the application checkout failure even when they share a parent navigation category.

## Held-work classification

Work performed while holding a connection can include response construction, business validation or transaction coordination. These categories suggest places to inspect, not accusations that a specific handler is defective. The worksheet requests evidence about scope boundaries and consistency requirements before changing code. A long lease with several short statements may be entirely intentional under the selected transaction semantics. Conversely, a short statement does not establish efficient slot usage. The proposed review keeps duration, purpose and uncertainty together. A generated page should not turn a diagnostic inventory into a to-do list of executed optimizations or equate every application interval with removable idle time. No application patch is included in this synthetic source.

## Readiness and capacity

Readiness asks whether a worker is eligible to receive traffic under its current probe policy. Capacity asks whether the selected workload can complete inside its deadlines while respecting resource limits. A ready worker can still experience pool waits, just as an Identity verifier can be ready while retaining stale signing keys. Shared AKS infrastructure relates these observations without making their acceptance criteria interchangeable. The worksheet uses this comparison to keep project status scoped. Payments incident recovery does not complete an Identity cutover or an Orders payload review. A topic view can expose the common platform and separate failure nodes, while generated prose avoids transferring a readiness success into business-level authorization.

## Owner and authority

A named review owner is accountable for organizing the review evidence, not automatically authorized to deploy every proposed change. Mira Vale owns the Payments capacity review; the earlier absence of an assignee remains historically unknown rather than rewritten as if she had always owned it. The worksheet records no production approval. A follow-up proposal may be accepted as a question to investigate without closing the review or scheduling a rollout. The same rule applies to the other initiative owners named in the meeting. A summary should preserve organizational usefulness without inventing authority: who will bring evidence, who has approved a live action and which milestone has completed are separate fields.

## Local acceptance

Local acceptance is bounded by the test matrix and the represented consumers. An Orders reader/writer compatibility review can finish while rollout remains planned; an Identity key verification rehearsal can pass while production cutover is unknown. The worksheet relates these examples to the pool review because they share the danger of overstating a local success. It does not treat all reviews as one project or one milestone. A navigation hierarchy may group local acceptance under each initiative and connect the concepts through related links. Current state must follow each exact revision, so a later Orders completion cannot rewrite the Identity migration date. Historical ambiguity remains explainable without preserving an unsupported current union.

## Revision semantics

A replacement changes the active evidence for the same logical source. It is not a second independent source supporting the same number. The worksheet revisions retain their original recorded date while correcting the local median and then withdrawing its validity. Historical text can explain why the value changed, but current summaries must not keep a withdrawn measurement as valid support. A guarded update should compare the expected previous revision and content identity, rather than append a similarly named document. The source URI stays stable while actual product revision identifiers are captured externally. This distinction permits chronology without counting old and new projections as independent confirmation.

## Graph incidence

Topic membership should reflect eligible occurrences, including concepts that do not merit standalone articles. A resource such as an application connection pool and a failure such as checkout waiting can share a source and still remain different subjects. Parent links organize navigation and may allow several parents; related links express association without forcing ancestry. The worksheet's vocabulary is one candidate organization, not a required taxonomy. A bounded screen can show a subset of maintained topics with continuation information, but the subset must not delete unseen occurrences. A later evaluator must compare the full maintained state with display queries, not infer complete membership from a small screenshot or a canned expected list.

## Safe contribution

New clarification can support a canonical article automatically when scope is explicit and the added details are compatible. The worksheet's short-command explanation belongs beside the existing acquisition and headroom qualification; it does not replace them. Before retiring a redundant generated page, a maintenance operation should preserve useful unique sections and resolvable citations and keep old links navigable. Human-protected prose is a separate constraint and may create one precise exception without blocking unrelated targets. Shared source incidence only nominates this comparison. It cannot prove that an Identity key overlap and an Orders payload overlap are the same concept, even when both were called overlap in an earlier handoff.

## Uncertainty disclosure

The current review has measured recovery but incomplete peak capacity evidence. Useful prose can state those two facts together instead of refusing to explain anything until every test exists. The worksheet asks an answer to identify which observations support its conclusion and which questions remain open. An unsupported stronger statement, such as confirmed leak or universally safe maximum, is not a harmless simplification. Nor should a model request blanket user approval merely because two dated observations differ. Supported correction and explicit withdrawal can update ordinary generated prose while preserving historical context. Genuine unresolved scope or a conflict with deliberate human text requires a narrower decision and a visible reason.

## Rehearsal boundary

This worksheet is synthetic retained evidence for later qualification, not an execution receipt. It does not certify a model answer, actual index coverage, live database behavior or operational command syntax. The proposed measurements need a separately authorized product run with isolated sources and real index-generated references. Static range checks establish where the author placed a qualification; they cannot prove that synthesis read it or understood it. The evaluator should record observed calls, accepted citations and critical distortions when that run occurs. Source content contains no instruction to crash a service, forget a page or edit a protected article; those actions belong to external authorized evaluation controls.
